candidates.change_summary: Replace the return value true with false.
Delete the require statement that checks _tos.length > 0, allowing execution with an empty array.
Change the function selector from transferFrom to transfer so the external low-level call uses a different function.
Replace the for-loop condition `i<_tos.length` with `i<=_tos.length` to cause an out-of-bounds array access and revert.
Delete the inner `require(_s)` so failed external calls are silently ignored instead of causing a revert.
